item: Docs consistency sweep: the cycle<->version mapping aligned to the release gates (cycle 0.N => v0.N.0; the 0.09->0.1.0 exception kept), the ROADMAP moved to the 0.5 cycle, ARCHITECTURE corrected to lanes and the twelve translated locales, the pre-alpha labels updated, the AUDIT_TRAIL backfilled with audits 13-16, the USER_MANUAL env-var table given an honesty note, and the HISTORY TOC anchors repaired
key_paths: README.md; AUDIT_TRAIL.md; docs/README.md; docs/CONTRIBUTING.md; docs/QUICKSTART.md; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md; docs/ETHICS.md; docs/ROADMAP.md; docs/HISTORY.md; docs/CHANGES.md; docs/USER_MANUAL.md
summary: A full-documentation audit found the docs contradicting each other and the code. Ground truth for the cycle<->version mapping is the release gates themselves (RELEASE_0.4_GATE.md is "the checkable inventory for closing the 0.4 cycle" and v0.4.0 closed it): since the first alpha, each 0.N cycle closes with v0.N.0, the one exception being the consolidated 0.09 cycle that produced 0.1.0. CHANGES.md was the outlier (it offset every cycle by one) - its header sentence and its 0.2.0/0.3.0/0.4.0 release headings are aligned, and CONTRIBUTING now states the rule explicitly where the retired branch names are listed. Stale-status fixes: ROADMAP "where we are" was frozen in the 0.2 era and now opens the 0.5 cycle (RELEASE_0.5_GATE.md, the investigator’s desk), its versioned-sources section is marked SHIPPED in 0.4.0 (it was labelled "future version"; its FUTURE_DEVELOPMENTS.md link is dead and noted as since-retired), ARCHITECTURE’s scheduler table describes the 0.4 lanes (rss/crawl/markets/wiki/law side by side, per-lane storage, Living sources tab) instead of the retired single scheduler mode, and its i18n table marks the eight locales that were "stub -> community" as complete (translated in the 0.4 cycle, not yet vouched; verified 12 locale files at 6,991 keys each). QUICKSTART and ETHICS say alpha, not pre-alpha. AUDIT_TRAIL is backfilled with audits 13-16 from docs/audit/ (trail had stopped at 2026-09-08). USER_MANUAL 5.2 gains an honesty note: the table lists the operator-facing essentials, not every variable the code reads (an audit counted ~259 environment-variable references). 11 of HISTORY’s 12 TOC anchors were broken (em dashes, ampersands, the 0.02_Qubes slug); repaired to GitHub-correct slugs. Docs-only: no code, schema, locale or traffic changes; README version header 0.4.0 untouched.
